newsitem.title: USA: CFM Int'l gets $750 mln engine order from AMR.
newsitem.headline: CFM Int'l gets $750 mln engine order from AMR.

text.p: CFM International, a joint venture between SNECMA of France and General Electric Co, said it will provide engines for 75 American Airlines 737 aircraft. The CFM56-7 engine deal is valued at more than $750 million, CFM said.
AMR Corp, the parent of American Airlines, ordered 103 Boeing Co jets, including 75 Boeing 737s.
AMR also has purchase rights to acquire an additional 527 planes, the bulk of which would be 737s.
The 757s and 767s, like existing models in AMR's fleet, will have Rolls-Royce Plc and General Electric engines, respectively.
AMR also is in talks with manufacturers for engines for the 777s. The carrier declined to comment on when it will name an engine maker for those jets.
